data.title: Bitcoin jumps 26% after largest short squeeze s... | Pluang
data.description: Bitcoin surged 26% from its mid-August low following the largest single-day short liquidation event since 2019, with 85% of liquidated positions being shorts. During this period, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $2.23 billion in creations, indicating strong spot-market demand that supported the price rise despite a decline in leveraged futures positions. Futures open interest fell 11% in Bitcoin terms, showing the rally was not fueled by increased leverage. The market now watches if spot demand and futures leverage will grow together or if the rally will continue with subdued leverage.
data.author: Tokenpost
